string.text: {=mfyline000}My name is Sonadel. I'm helping my parents, who are blacksmiths.
{=mfyline001}But lately, I've been getting tired of it. It's my wish to see the wider world.
{=mfyline002}Although my father didn't teach me smithing, I know a little bit!
{=mfyline003}I've taken charge of trading and managing the store instead of my parents. I'm sure I can be of help.
{=mfyline004}Those experiences are also useful in the party.
{=mfyline005}You still seem inexperienced.
{=mfyline006}If possible, I would like to work in your party. I secretly made my sword for a day like this!
{=mfyline010}I'm Anette...
{=mfyline011}I joined a group selling goods in the town with my parents and the village's permission.
{=mfyline012}But then a war broke out, and I couldn't go back.
{=mfyline013}When I returned, the village was in flames, and that's why I'm here now.
{=mfyline014}That's truly unfortunate.
{=mfyline015}It's a common occurrence in these times.
{=mfyline016}To be honest, I have nowhere to go. Although I haven't learned any special skills beyond handling farming tools, I'm ready to work hard to learn.
{=mfyline020}My name is Qiana. I was a girl from an ordinary peasant family.
{=mfyline021}But my father couldn't overlook the many injustices between duty and distribution, and just like that, our ordinary days ended.
{=mfyline022}I had to learn to survive in the wild. My father sometimes brought back food from places I didn’t know.
{=mfyline023}One day, while I was sleeping in the cave, there was a loud commotion, and my father suddenly kicked me out, handing me a bow and arrow.
{=mfyline024}I can guess what happened...
{=mfyline025}I was wondering where it smelled.
{=mfyline026}I've managed to survive so far, but I don't want to walk the same path my father did.
{=mfyline030}I know it sounds weird, but listen.
{=mfyline031}I think I was in this world before but I have a faint memory.
{=mfyline032}I don't care anyway, but there are some people who remember me for some reason.
{=mfyline033}But the problem is not only that, but I don't remember everything.
{=mfyline034}Oh, I hope you can remember.
{=mfyline035}You're just saying you don't have any skills.
{=mfyline036}I think I'll get used to it soon if you help.
{=mfyline040}My name is Belladona. Sadly, I was kicked out of my village.
{=mfyline041}I accidentally gave the villagers something else instead of the herbs I was supposed to use.
{=mfyline042}But it's not my fault! The group of girls my age who were jealous must have set me up.
{=mfyline043}Suddenly, rumors spread that I was a red-haired witch, and I had to run away before the witch hunt began.
{=mfyline044}Everyone can make mistakes.
{=mfyline045}I bet you have a big cauldron in your house.
{=mfyline046}I know how to distinguish and handle herbs even though I haven't learned them formally.
{=mfyline050}I used to work at the inn in the next town.
{=mfyline051}However, the inn started having more and more customers, and the workload became overwhelming.
{=mfyline052}I didn't realize it at first, but before I knew it, the inn was being called the Big Linda Inn.
{=mfyline053}Then, I happened to find it less enjoyable, so I decided to quit.
{=mfyline054}What if there's something more fun?
{=mfyline055}Well, are you saying you had fun during that time?
{=mfyline056}I have enough money to eat for now, so I might consider traveling if you have any suggestions for a little more money.
{=mfyline060}My name is Adrianne, and my father, a woodcutter, taught me how to chop wood with an axe.
{=mfyline061}Later, it turned out, my father didn't learn how to use an axe by cutting down trees.
{=mfyline062}My father had many enemies around him. He was eventually killed one day by them.
{=mfyline063}They killed my father and stormed my house, I held my father's axe.
{=mfyline064}So you got your father's revenge?
{=mfyline065}I guess you didn't use your axe just for cutting down trees, either.
{=mfyline066}No, I prepared for a fight, but somehow they didn't attack me. I guess they thought their revenge was over. I was kicked out of my village instead.
{=mfyline070}My name is Laura.
{=mfyline071}My parents are engineers who build large structures.
{=mfyline072}They started a new project in this town, so I'm here, too.
{=mfyline073}Meeting you must be the beginning of a new job for me. I can and should do my part now.
{=mfyline074}I think it's a good opportunity for me, too.
{=mfyline075}I doubt you can do your part...
{=mfyline076}I learned engineers, but I was also in charge of procuring the necessary items for my parents' business.
{=mfyline080}I think you've at least heard of my clan's name.
{=mfyline081}I already have a lot to eat at home, but I don't understand why my parents keep trying to push me out.
{=mfyline082}So I was forced to come outside by my parents to see the world.
{=mfyline083}Are you running a party by any chance?
{=mfyline085}Um, I don't need a princess.
{=mfyline086}I hope the party I'm joining has enough foods to keep us well-fed.
{=mfyline090}People in my hometown don't feel the need for engineering at all.
{=mfyline091}I like to shoot arrows on horseback, but I'm also interested in researching and producing them.
{=mfyline092}I came here to study because it's hard to study like this near my house.
{=mfyline093}But it's hard to make money here, so at this rate, I have to quit quickly and go back.
{=mfyline094}I think you can achieve the things you want together.
{=mfyline095}Why don't you just follow what your family tells you to do?
{=mfyline096}Anyway, I need work. Even more so if it's something I can gain experience with.
{=mfyline100}I was a caravan guard, but I had to run away after meeting a large band of bandits.
{=mfyline101}I followed their trail and reported it to the lord, but he didn't care.
{=mfyline102}So I had no choice but to go to a hideout to save those caught alone and come back injured.
{=mfyline103}Our caravan is gone, so I don't know what to do.
{=mfyline104}You're a very responsible person.
{=mfyline105}So you're saying you've been running away?
{=mfyline106}I'm good at tracking enemies and I know how to deal with horse-riding weapons.
{=mfyline110}I learned medicine from surgeons and South area's scholars.
{=mfyline111}But in recent years, there's been a lot of wars, so we have all been called somewhere, and so have I.
{=mfyline112}After going through several caravans to and from the village, I’ve ended up too far.
{=mfyline113}Now, I want to work in one place, not just a wandering.
{=mfyline114}You seem to have studied a lot.
{=mfyline115}It depends on what you do.
{=mfyline116}I've learned not only medicine, but also the trading skills of caravans.
{=mfyline120}I've never stopped fighting since I was a kid.
{=mfyline121}I had to survive these chaotic times and I learned sword and archery.
{=mfyline122}Right now, I'm doing anything that makes money.
{=mfyline123}Would an introduction be enough?
{=mfyline125}I shouldn't have asked.
{=mfyline126}I don't like talking about myself.
{=mfyline130}I left my village a few years ago. But my mercenary life with my dad was more suitable for me.
{=mfyline131}Even in the group where my dad was, I was recognized for my skills, but the problem was a shameless woman.
{=mfyline132}She kept framing my dad behind back for not following. I got angry and asked for a duel, but I lost.
{=mfyline133}As soon as the defeat was confirmed and she insulted me, her neck was suddenly cut off in front of my eyes. Dad was a gentle person, unlike me, so I was surprised.
{=mfyline134}He put up with the slander of himself.
{=mfyline135}It looks like that impulsiveness runs in the family.
{=mfyline136}We ended up being kicked out. Dad found a new wife in the meantime and settled down in a village. But I find this life more interesting.
{=mfyline140}You look like someone who leads a troop. It’s an honor that you show interest in me.
{=mfyline141}I have three younger brothers, each with remarkable talents. Gradually, supporting those three became the most important part of my life.
{=mfyline142}When even the youngest received the lord’s favor and left home for his mission, I rejoiced at his success, but in the end I was left alone in a house where everyone had gone.
{=mfyline143}Was this what I truly wanted? Was this all that I had accomplished? Such thoughts began to arise.
{=mfyline144}You have done admirable work.
{=mfyline145}Hmm… it seems you don’t have many skills that would be useful to the troops…
{=mfyline146}But I am confident in my stamina and persistence. Those are my strengths!
{=mfyline150}I grew up under the captain who adopted me, thinking the harsh sea breeze was actually quite refreshing.
{=mfyline151}The mutiny broke out without warning, but the captain was a veteran. He narrowly fended off the pursuers, shoved me onto a raft, and cut the lines.
{=mfyline152}The traitors were desperate to silence any witnesses. I managed to escape, but at the last second, a javelin pierced right through the captain.
{=mfyline153}The raft was heavy, but I couldn't bring myself to leave him behind in the sea. I rowed to shore alone and buried him deep beneath the beach sands.
{=mfyline154}I don't even want to imagine what that must have been like.
{=mfyline155}You nearly died yourself for the sake of a dead man.
{=mfyline156}I've only now realized that the reason those harsh winds felt so 'refreshing' was all because of the captain.
{=mfyline160}I'm just an ordinary traveler. That's all.
{=mfyline163}Hm? So?
{=mfyline164}You say you're ordinary? I am a great adventurer.
{=mfyline166}Well, there's not much to tell.
